\documentclass[9pt]{extarticle}

\usepackage[a4paper, landscape, margin=1.5cm]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{times}
\usepackage{csvsimple-l3}
\usepackage{xstring}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\usepackage{pifont}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
    \pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usepackage{tabularray}
    \UseTblrLibrary{booktabs}
\usepackage{url}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

\newcommand{\datafile}{data/flatsat_platforms.tsv}

% ---- Symbols (same style as the papers) --------------
\newcommand{\yessym}{{\color{green!50!black}\ding{51}}}
\newcommand{\nosym}{{\color{red!70!black}\ding{55}}}

% ---- Counters for the summary and charts -------------
\newcommand{\cnt}[1]{\newcounter{#1}}
\cnt{total}\cnt{raw}\cnt{bridge}\cnt{dock}\cnt{modular}
\cnt{struct}\cnt{bp}\cnt{passive}\cnt{active}
\cnt{sens}\cnt{sw}\cnt{pwr}\cnt{mon}\cnt{std}\cnt{cpld}
\cnt{func}\cnt{miss}\cnt{therm}\cnt{emc}
\newcounter{minyear}\setcounter{minyear}{9999}
\newcounter{maxyear}
\newcounter{yr}
\pgfplotsforeachungrouped \y in {1990,...,2050}{\newcounter{y\y}}
\newcommand{\ifyes}[2]{\ifcsvstrcmp{#1}{yes}{\stepcounter{#2}}{}}

% ---- Table body builder ------------------------------
% The rows are collected in \tbody and expanded inside the longtblr.
\newcommand{\tbody}{}
\newcommand{\addraw}[1]{\gappto\tbody{#1}}
\newcommand{\addval}[1]{\xappto\tbody{\expandonce{#1}}}
\newcommand{\addorDash}[1]{\ifcsvstrcmp{#1}{}{\addraw{-}}{\addval{#1}}}
\newcommand{\addyn}[1]{%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{#1}{yes}{\addraw{& \SetCell{bg=green!20}\yessym}}{%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{#1}{no}{\addraw{& \SetCell{bg=red!20}\nosym}}{\addraw{& -}}}}
\newcommand{\addtype}[1]{%
  \def\sep{}%
  \IfSubStr{#1}{raw}{\xappto\tbody{\sep Raw}\def\sep{/}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{#1}{bridge}{\xappto\tbody{\sep Bridge}\def\sep{/}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{#1}{dock}{\xappto\tbody{\sep Dock}\def\sep{/}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{#1}{modular}{\xappto\tbody{\sep Modular}}{}}

\begin{document}

\begin{center}
  {\Large\bfseries FlatSat platforms for small satellites: systematic mapping}\\[4pt]
  J.\,C.\,E. Barcellos
\end{center}

This document lists the works analyzed in the systematic mapping published in
J.\,C.\,E. Barcellos \textit{et al.}, ``FlatSat Platforms for Small Satellites: A Systematic Mapping and Classification,''
\textit{IEEE Journal on Miniaturization for Air and Space Systems}, vol.~4, no.~2, pp.~186--198, 2023,
doi: \href{https://doi.org/10.1109/JMASS.2023.3249044}{10.1109/JMASS.2023.3249044}.
It is generated from \texttt{data/flatsat\_platforms.tsv} and \texttt{data/references.bib}, which may be expanded and corrected over time.

% ---- Single pass: counters and table rows ------------
\csvreader[separator=tab, respect and]{\datafile}{}{%
  \stepcounter{total}%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolix}{raw}{\stepcounter{raw}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolix}{bridge}{\stepcounter{bridge}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolix}{dock}{\stepcounter{dock}}{}%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolix}{modular}{\stepcounter{modular}}{}%
  \ifyes{\csvcolxi}{struct}%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolx}{backplane}{\stepcounter{bp}}{}%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{\csvcolxii}{passive}{\stepcounter{passive}}{}%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{\csvcolxii}{active}{\stepcounter{active}}{}%
  \ifyes{\csvcolxiii}{sens}\ifyes{\csvcolxiv}{sw}\ifyes{\csvcolxv}{pwr}%
  \ifyes{\csvcolxvi}{mon}\ifyes{\csvcolxvii}{std}\ifyes{\csvcolxviii}{cpld}%
  \ifyes{\csvcolxix}{func}\ifyes{\csvcolxx}{miss}\ifyes{\csvcolxxi}{therm}\ifyes{\csvcolxxii}{emc}%
  \setcounter{yr}{\csvcolv}%
  \stepcounter{y\csvcolv}%
  \ifnum\value{yr}<\value{minyear}\setcounter{minyear}{\value{yr}}\fi
  \ifnum\value{yr}>\value{maxyear}\setcounter{maxyear}{\value{yr}}\fi
  % row of the main table
  \addval{\csvcoli}\addraw{& }%
  \xappto\tbody{\noexpand\cite{\csvcolii}}\addraw{& }%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{\csvcoliii}{}{\addorDash{\csvcoliv}}{\addval{\csvcoliii}}%
  \addraw{& }\addval{\csvcolv}\addraw{& }\addtype{\csvcolix}\addraw{& }%
  \IfSubStr{\csvcolx}{;}{\addraw{Both}}{\IfSubStr{\csvcolx}{wire}{\addraw{Wire}}{\addraw{Backplane}}}%
  \addyn{\csvcolxi}%
  \ifcsvstrcmp{\csvcolxii}{passive}{\addraw{& Passive}}{\ifcsvstrcmp{\csvcolxii}{active}{\addraw{& Active}}{\addraw{& -}}}%
  \addyn{\csvcolxiii}\addyn{\csvcolxiv}\addyn{\csvcolxv}\addyn{\csvcolxvi}\addyn{\csvcolxvii}\addyn{\csvcolxviii}%
  \addyn{\csvcolxix}\addyn{\csvcolxx}\addyn{\csvcolxxi}\addyn{\csvcolxxii}%
  \addraw{\\}%
}

% year list for the chart (from the first to the last year in the data)
\def\yearcoords{}
\edef\ymin{\arabic{minyear}}\edef\ymax{\arabic{maxyear}}

  \xappto\yearcoords{(\y,\arabic{y\y})}}

\noindent
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    title={Works per year}, width=0.48\linewidth, height=5cm,
    ybar, bar width=7pt, ymin=0, xtick=data, xticklabel style={rotate=90, /pgf/number format/1000 sep=},
    nodes near coords, nodes near coords style={font=\scriptsize}, enlarge x limits=0.04,
    axis lines*=left, ymajorgrids, grid style={gray!25}, tick label style={font=\scriptsize},
    ]
    \addplot[fill=blue!40, draw=blue!60!black] coordinates {\yearcoords};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}\hfill

  \begin{axis}[
    title={Type of platform}, width=0.25\linewidth, height=5cm,

    nodes near coords, nodes near coords style={font=\scriptsize}, enlarge x limits=0.2,

    ]
    \addplot[fill=orange!50, draw=orange!70!black] coordinates
      {(Raw,\arabic{raw}) (Bridge,\arabic{bridge}) (Dock,\arabic{dock}) (Modular,\arabic{modular})};

\end{tikzpicture}\hfill

    axis lines*=left, ymajorgrids, grid style={gray!25}, tick label style={font=\scriptsize},

      {(Functional,\arabic{func}) (Mission,\arabic{miss}) (Thermal,\arabic{therm}) (EMC,\arabic{emc})};

\end{tikzpicture}
